title: StackRewards
tagline: StackRewards is an employee motivation system on L2! We make working in Scrum fun & rewarding!
description:
Introducing "StackRewards", the next-generation employee motivation system built on Ethereum's Layer 2! Agile working just got a lot more exciting. With StackRewards, the traditional Kanban board experience is elevated. Now, not only do you get to organize and prioritize tasks seamlessly, but each task also comes with a tangible incentive!

Features:

Tokenized Tasks: Every task on the Kanban board has an associated reward. Successfully complete your task, have it reviewed, and you're in for a treat! Earn ERC-20 tokens or exclusive NFTs on Zora for your hard work.

Seamless Integration: Worried about the onboarding process? With ERC-4337 wallet support, employees can effortlessly log in using their existing G Suite or Office 365 accounts, making the transition into StackRewards smooth and straightforward.

Enhanced Scrum Engagement: Gone are the days when Scrum was just a methodology. With StackRewards, it's an adventure! Engage in tasks as you would challenges in a game, knowing there's a rewarding end.

Trust & Transparency: Built on the blockchain, StackRewards offers a transparent system where rewards are automatically dispensed upon successful task completion and review, eliminating any manual intervention or bias.

StackRewards is here to revolutionize the way teams approach Scrum. By merging the principles of agile working with the incentivizing powers of blockchain technology, we aim to foster a more rewarding, engaging, and challenging work environment for everyone.

Join us in making Agile not just a working model, but a rewarding experience!
how_its_made:
Frontend Development:
The user interface (UI) of StackRewards is built on the robust framework of Next.js. This choice ensures a smooth, efficient, and optimized web experience for all users. Whether you're an employee looking to claim your reward or a manager setting up tasks, the frontend ensures a seamless experience.

Integration with ZeroDev:
A crucial aspect that sets StackRewards apart is its integration with ZeroDev's 4337 stack. By leveraging this, StackRewards can provide several notable advantages:

Simplified Onboarding: The stack facilitates easy integration, ensuring that both setup and regular usage are straightforward.
Fee Sponsorship via Paymaster: One of the pain points in many blockchain-based applications is the transaction fee. With the integration of ZeroDev's Paymaster infrastructure, StackRewards can sponsor these transaction fees for employees. This approach removes barriers and potential disincentives, making the reward claiming process hassle-free for the end-user.
Backend & Smart Contracts:
The heart of StackRewards lies in its smart contracts, meticulously crafted using Solidity. These contracts ensure the secure allocation and dispensation of rewards in the form of ERC-20 tokens or NFTs on the Zora platform. The solidity contracts are at the core of the trust and transparency that StackRewards promises, guaranteeing that rewards are given out justly and promptly upon task completion and review.
